_note: School and personality XP, design doc sections 8.3 and 8.4. Every number is a first guess. `levels` are cumulative XP thresholds, level 1 at index 0; past the end each level costs `past_end_step` more. A level's reward runs once, the first time the level is reached.
_school_note: Each school level adds `school_batch` cards of that school to the collection, one copy each, in pool order (cards printed at higher limits first, then by id). Once every card has had a copy the pool starts over, and copies past the collection cap dust into Motes. Levels in `mastery_levels` also add the school's next Mastery.
_tracks_note: Authored personality milestones, keyed by character. A level may give `cards` (into the collection), `starter` (opens that starter), and `abilities` (for every starter of that character: start_relic, start_reserve). A character with no track here gets two of their own signature cards per level, in id order.
